walkthroughs.body_html:
Aspects of Political Life in the French-speaking World — a core area of A-Level French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Aspects of Political Life in the French-speaking World brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Aspects of Political Life in the French-speaking World.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is 'la Francophonie' as a political organisation?
options: Only mainland France's regions
Simply the French government
An international body promoting cooperation among French-speaking states

mcqs.q: What does decolonisation refer to in francophone political history?
options: The process by which former colonies gained independence from France
France joining the EU
The founding of the Fifth Republic
